queries: WITH g AS (SELECT AlbumId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS bytes_per_ms FROM Track GROUP BY AlbumId) SELECT AlbumId, avg_unit_price, bytes_per_ms, bytes_per_ms - (SELECT AVG(bytes_per_ms) FROM g) AS diff_from_avg FROM g WHERE bytes_per_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The 'average rate across all albums' is the unweighted mean of the per-group rates. The NULL-AlbumId group counts as one group in that mean.
Each track's rate is Bytes/Milliseconds. Tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored in the averages. A Milliseconds value of 0 is treated as missing. Groups whose rate is NULL are excluded from the ranking.
Rates use decimal division, with no rounding.

alternatives.interpretation: The baseline is the average rate over all individual tracks, not the mean of the per-album rates.

assumptions.assumption: The 'average rate across all albums' is the mean of the per-album rates, with each group (including the NULL-album group) counted once. It is not weighted by track count.
Each track's rate is Bytes/Milliseconds, computed in floating point. Tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored in the rate average. Groups whose rate is NULL are excluded from the ranking.
The NULL AlbumId tracks form a single group, which GROUP BY does by default.

alternatives.interpretation: The baseline is the average rate over all individual tracks (track-weighted), not the average of the album-level rates.

assumptions.assumption: The average rate across all albums is the unweighted mean of the per-group rates. The NULL-AlbumId group counts as one group in that mean. Groups with no computable rate are ignored.
Each track's rate is Bytes*1.0/Milliseconds, so the division is not integer division. Tracks with NULL Bytes are ignored in the averages. Milliseconds is NOT NULL, and I assume it is never 0.
Groups whose rate is NULL (every track has NULL Bytes) are excluded from the top 10, because their difference is NULL.

alternatives.interpretation: The overall average rate is taken over all individual tracks (track-weighted), not over the album-level averages.
